exposure: >50% elevated blood pressures within 24 h prior to discharge
outcome: ED visit or readmission for postpartum hypertension
cohort: The study included birthing patients aged 18 years or above with peripartum hypertension who delivered and had any ED visit or readmission at a single tertiary care center between 2017 and 2022.
finding: Maternal age 40 years and above, chronic hypertension, preeclampsia with severe features, prescription of anti-hypertensives on discharge, and elevated blood pressures leading up to discharge are independently associated with postpartum ED visits or readmissions for hypertension.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was identified as a risk factor for postpartum ED visits or readmissions for hypertension.
